# PlanOnce v1.0.0

PlanOnce is an open-source production engineering control layer for AI coding agents. It routes work to the smallest safe Greenfield/Brownfield workflow, establishes one accepted planning authority, executes inside bounded scope, verifies revision-bound evidence, and keeps the final ship decision human-readable.

## Canonical website documentation

- /docs/ - Overview and v1.0 contract
- /docs/getting-started/ - Install, verify, and run the first controlled task
- /docs/workflows/ - Greenfield/Brownfield Small, Normal, and Large routes
- /docs/reliability/ - Plan fingerprint, fresh evidence, failure routing, workspace safety
- /docs/architecture/ - PlanOnce authority, Agent OS 3.0.0, GSD Core 1.12.0
- /docs/providers/ - 14 provider targets and discovery paths
- /docs/security-review/ - Security, finding-scoped fixes, readiness, supply-chain review
- /docs/artifacts/ - CONTEXT, DESIGN, PLAN, STATE, VERIFY schemas
- /docs/evals/ - Deterministic workflow evaluation harness
- /docs/troubleshooting/ - Provider discovery and workflow recovery
- /docs/design-system/ - Orbital visual/motion/accessibility contributor contract

## Release facts

- Version: 1.0.0
- Agent Skills: 12
- Workflows: 6
- Provider targets: 14
- First-class adapters: 11

- GSD Core pin: 1.12.0

Core repository engineering truth takes precedence over explanatory website prose when they differ.
